conversation.user: I have about 420 sq. ft. of exterior wall area and want 10-inch walls. What volume is that?
conversation.assistant:
For 420 square feet of exterior wall area with a 10-inch thickness, the authoritative planning volume is **9.9 cubic metres** of hemp-lime material. 

Please note that this calculation provides the raw planning volume for your walls, while actual material quantities, structural engineering specs, pricing, and local building permits will depend on your specific site conditions and engineering requirements.
